_comment: D5 regression case list. The runner reads this file only; pass/fail is decided from the structured RESULT_FILE each simulation writes, never from log text.

cases.name: neg_wrong_golden
cases.note: negative control: the checker must reject a deliberately wrong golden

cases.name: neg_illegal_desc
cases.note: negative control: width 2 must raise the sticky protocol error

cases.name: rand
cases.note: constrained random draw of legal cases, fixed seed so a failure can be replayed

cases.name: neg_lfnst_xform
cases.note: LFNST enabled with a non-zero transform type, illegal per wrapper:775

cases.name: neg_lfnst_mode3
cases.note: LFNST mode 3 is not an allowed encoding, see wrapper:780

cases.name: neg_addr_overrun
cases.note: beat addressed past the TU's last point, caught at wrapper:2434

cases.name: neg_stray_end
cases.note: end marker with no TU outstanding, caught at wrapper:2438

cases.name: neg_no_end
cases.note: fill never closed, so the TU must never produce a beat

cases.name: neg_short_beats
cases.note: truncated input closes the TU but cannot reproduce the golden

cases.name: reset_mid_tu
cases.note: reset while beats are streaming; only the post-reset TU must complete

cases.name: vseq_multi_agent
cases.note: virtual sequence drives the stimulus agent while the back-pressure agent changes profile underneath it

cases.name: neg_zero_data
cases.note: end marker inside the pre-fill scrub window: the DUT retires the TU with no data, so it cannot reproduce the golden

cases.name: neg_desc_flood
cases.note: four descriptors pushed while the scrub window blocks bind_event, tripping the queue-full guard

cases.name: neg_end_only_fill
cases.note: end-only marker after the fill window opened: no data command, so the slot completes without a phantom write

cases.name: tail_stress
cases.note: widest TU against a long output-grant blackout: stalls the H-pass consumer so the raw-response tail buffer fills
